company.name: Fertiglobe
company.shortDescription: Fertiglobe focuses on the production and marketing of nitrogen-based fertilizers, including urea and ammonia.
company.description: Fertiglobe manufactures urea, ammonia, and other gas-based fertilizers for export and distribution. The company's product line includes ammonia, urea for agricultural and industrial users, and DEF for industrial customers, which is also known as AdBlue and sold as AdGreen by FERTIL.

productsAndServices.description: A solid nitrogen fertilizer with approximately 46% nitrogen content, produced from ammonia and carbon dioxide under high pressure and temperature.
productsAndServices.name: Granular Urea

productsAndServices.description: A colorless gas composed of nitrogen and hydrogen, used as a key industrial chemical and nitrogen fertilizer, produced under high temperature and pressure.
productsAndServices.name: Ammonia

productsAndServices.description: Ammonia produced using hydrogen derived from electrolysis powered by renewable electricity, reducing carbon emissions.
productsAndServices.name: Renewable Ammonia

productsAndServices.description: Ammonia produced using low-carbon hydrogen derived from natural gas with carbon capture technology to reduce emissions.
productsAndServices.name: Low Carbon Ammonia

productsAndServices.description: A non-hazardous aqueous urea solution used to reduce nitrogen oxide emissions from diesel engines, consisting of about 32.5% urea and 67.5% deionized water.
productsAndServices.name: Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF)
